summary: RFC 7118 defines a WebSocket subprotocol for SIP, and this document updates the SIP Common Log Format from RFC 6873 with a new Transport Flag for SIP over WebSocket. That way logs can show when a SIP message used that transport.

eli5.summary: When a diary records how each message arrived, it needs a letter for each way. This RFC adds a new letter for messages that traveled over WebSocket.
